summary: Which VS Code versions do Cursor, Windsurf and VSCodium ship, and what floor should the Cockpit set?

resolution.gist: Recommended floor is VS Code 1.105.0 (Node constraint, not APIs) with @types/vscode ~1.105.0; Windsurf caps it at 1.126.0; the forks lag 2–8.5 months behind VS Code releases.

warnings: Answer in closing comment only; body is the question
Node versions checked only on Linux x64 builds
Cursor and Windsurf behavior inside the forks not verified, only declared versions
